appraisal_events.evidence: elle se plaignit que ce fût en effet bien tard... elle se sentait mal à la tête et le prévint qu’elle ne le garderait pas plus d’une demi-heure... — Alors, pas de catleyas ce soir ?... — Mais non, mon petit, pas de catleyas ce soir, tu vois bien que je suis souffrante !
appraisal_events.explanation: Odette receives Swann with complaint, limits his visit to half an hour, and flatly refuses the intimacy ('catleyas') he had hoped for, citing her illness.

status_effects.explanation: Swann arrives eager for intimacy after braving a stormy night and is instead met with complaint, a strict time limit, and outright refusal — a clear emotional rebuff.
Odette controls the length and terms of the visit and withholds the intimacy Swann seeks, giving her the emotional upper hand.
